firstPlayerRule: The player with the loudest voice takes the first Construction turn.
houseFallback: If this criterion does not suit your group, agree to choose randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: First, all players complete the Production Phase. Give the loudest-voiced player the First Expedition Card; that holder starts Construction, followed by clockwise turns.
With three to five players, pass hands left after everyone has taken a turn. The new First Expedition Card holder starts the next round of turns.
With two players, the starter stays the same throughout that Construction Phase. The other player starts in the next Era.
Solo mode omits the First Expedition Card. You take your action before adding and resolving a Solo Card for GURPS.

internalEvidence: Starting instructions were checked on rendered publisher pages, including relevant mode context. Publisher source context: https://sinisterfish.com/product/moon/. Finding: The player with the loudest voice takes the first Construction turn. Local source SHA-256: f08f9db2892390e99d716bbb1b29a766ffc06922fbcfb7141e2193917136d199. The publisher product labels the linked English PDF v1.0; its credits state ©2023. Although this is a pick-and-pass game, page 8 explicitly assigns sequential Construction turns. Production happens before the first Construction turn. The First Expedition passes again at Construction's end on page 18. Rover comparisons on that page resolve Flag Rewards, not the initial starter.
uncertainty: No starting tie-break is stated alongside this instruction.
The answer applies to the identified publisher file; other editions may differ.
